feed.title: Re: Safer sighashes and more granular SIGHASH_NOINPUT

entry.title: Re: Safer sighashes and more granular SIGHASH_NOINPUT
entry.summary:
MAST, when integrated into taproot, significantly reduces the necessity for the OP_IF opcode and similar script functionalities. This change is not only technical but also enhances user privacy, as MAST provides a more private method for expressing spending conditions compared to traditional opcode-based branching.
Encouraging the adoption of MAST over expanding or upgrading the functionality of OP_IF helps maintain protocol simplicity and maximizes fungibility within the system. By focusing on MAST, the protocol avoids unnecessary complexity while promoting more uniform transaction structures, which ultimately benefits user privacy and the overall robustness of the network.
